# Offline dashboard dependency

`pyserial-3.5-py2.py3-none-any.whl` is the unmodified BSD-licensed wheel from
[PyPI's pyserial 3.5 release](https://pypi.org/project/pyserial/3.5/).
Its license and notices are included in the wheel. SHA-256:

`c4451db6ba391ca6ca299fb3ec7bae67a5c55dde170964c7a14ceefec02f2cf0`

The launcher verifies this hash and installs into this clone's `.venv` without
network access. Python itself must already be installed on each computer.
